data.content:
The Yards by Beyond Dubai will take shape in the City of Arabia, Dubai, introducing a landscape-led residential destination by Beyond Developments. Spanning 2.3 million square feet of gross floor area, the community will feature 1,560 residential units with thoughtfully designed one- to three-bedroom apartments.

Beyond Developments The Yards will focus on cultivated living, blending Mediterranean-inspired architecture with shaded walkways, green valleys, and community-focused spaces. Residents of The Yards City of Arabia will enjoy cafés, wellness zones, sports facilities, landscaped plazas, and essential conveniences integrated within the masterplan.

The first residential cluster within The Yards master community will be Arancia Yards, composed of three low-rise buildings surrounding a central landscaped valley. The Yards Dubai will also include community gardens, wellness amenities, retail areas, co-working spaces, pools, fitness facilities, and family-oriented recreational experiences.
